headline: Bajaj Electricals gets GST relief of ₹29.63 lakh
summary: Bajaj Electricals received a favourable appellate order setting aside a GST demand of ₹29.63 lakh for FY18, including a penalty of ₹2.69 lakh.

headline: Xtranet AGM approves all five resolutions
summary: Xtranet Technologies passed all five resolutions at its 25th AGM, including re-appointments of directors and adoption of FY26 financials.

headline: Signoria Creation wins Rs 2.85 crore order from Zivore Apparel
summary: Signoria Creation secured a Rs 2.85 crore work order for garment manufacturing. The order represents 5.8% of average quarterly revenue. No prior order history disclosed in last 3 quarters.

headline: Jaipan Industries shareholders approve FY26 financials
summary: Jaipan Industries Limited shareholders approved the adoption of audited financial statements for FY26 and reappointment of a director at its 60th AGM.

headline: Tandhan Power reappoints auditor for 5-year term
summary: Tandhan Energies Limited announced the re-appointment of M/s. N. Agarwala & Associates as statutory auditors of its material subsidiary, Tandhan Power Technologies Private Limited, for a second five-year term.

headline: Oscar Global AGM approves all nine resolutions
summary: Oscar Global Limited passed all nine resolutions at its 35th AGM, including director regularisations and capital increase. Voting showed 97.21% support.

headline: Liqvd Digital appoints Sonal Biyani as CS
summary: Liqvd Digital India Limited appointed Sonal Dilip Biyani as Company Secretary and Compliance Officer effective July 16, 2025, in compliance with SEBI regulations.

headline: Niks Technology passes 12 AGM resolutions
summary: Niks Technology Limited approved all 12 resolutions at its 12th AGM, including preferential share issues and capital changes. Voting saw zero dissent.

headline: Ravindra Energy promoter pledges 7.57 lakh shares
summary: Khandepar Investments Private Limited, a promoter entity of Ravindra Energy Limited, created a pledge on 7,57,000 equity shares valued at ₹11.21 crore.

headline: Godavari Biorefineries secures Mexican patent
summary: Godavari Biorefineries Ltd has received a patent grant from the Mexican Patent Office for compounds treating viral infections. The patent, valid until 2041, covers V-ATPase inhibition.

headline: Adani Ports handles 46 MMT cargo in Sep'26, up 11% YoY
summary: Adani Ports & SEZ reported 46 MMT cargo volume for September 2026, an 11% YoY rise driven by containers. H1 FY27 volumes hit 280 MMT, up 15% YoY.

headline: DIC India receives DRP directions on transfer pricing
summary: DIC India Limited received directions from the Dispute Resolution Panel regarding transfer pricing adjustments for FY23. The panel largely rejected company objections, directing the Assessing Officer to finalize the order.

headline: Aether Industries GST demand of ₹4.26 Cr dropped
summary: Authorities dropped a ₹4.26 crore GST demand and show cause notice against Aether Industries for FY21-22. The company confirmed no financial impact following the order.

headline: Shiva Granito to meet Oct 6 for preferential issue
summary: Shiva Granito Export Ltd board will consider raising funds via preferential equity shares and warrants on October 6, 2026.

headline: NCLT grants BN Agrochem 90-day extension for merger meetings
summary: The NCLT Mumbai Bench allowed a 90-day extension for convening shareholder and creditor meetings related to the scheme of amalgamation involving BN Agrochem.

headline: Virat Crane AGM voting results
summary: Virat Crane Industries Ltd submitted voting results for its 34th AGM held on September 30, 2026. Shareholders approved financial statements and director reappointment.

headline: Varroc appoints Anil Ghatiya as Compliance Officer
summary: Varroc Engineering Limited appointed Anil Ghatiya as Company Secretary and Compliance Officer on July 31, 2025. The company also confirmed MUFG Intime India as its Share Transfer Agent.

headline: TNA Solutions IPO Day 3: Subscribed 1.78x
summary: TNA Solutions IPO sees total subscription at 1.78x on Day 3. QIB leads with 4.77x demand, while Retail and NII categories remain below 1x.

headline: Dove Soft IPO Day 3: Subscribed 0.92x
summary: Dove Soft IPO remains undersubscribed at 0.92x on Day 3. QIB demand hits 1x, while Retail stands at 0.55x. Issue closes Oct 5.

headline: SJP Ultrasonic IPO Day 3: Subscribed 0.60x
summary: SJP Ultrasonic IPO stands at 0.60x overall on Day 3. bHNI leads at 0.82x while QIB remains at 0.00x. Issue closes on October 5, 2026.

headline: Vishal Nirmiti IPO Day 3: Subscribed 0.44x
summary: Vishal Nirmiti IPO sees weak demand on Day 3 with total subscription at 0.44x. QIB demand remains steady at 0.96x, while Retail interest stays low at 0.34x.

headline: EverestIMS IPO Day 4: Subscribed 1.78x
summary: EverestIMS Technologies IPO sees steady demand on Day 4 with overall subscription at 1.78x. Retail leads at 2.27x while QIB stands at 0.87x.

headline: Omara Ventures IPO Day 3 Update
summary: Omara Ventures IPO sees muted response on Day 3 with overall subscription at 0.75x. QIB category fully subscribed, while Retail demand remains low at 0.16x.

headline: Nityas Gems IPO Day 3: Retail leads at 0.72x
summary: Nityas Gems & Jewellery IPO stands at 0.43x overall on Day 3. Retail leads at 0.72x, while QIB is at 0.30x and bHNI lags at 0.14x. Issue closes on 5 October 2026.

headline: Acme India IPO Day 3: 2.05x Subscribed
summary: Acme India Industries IPO sees steady demand with total subscription at 2.05x. QIB leads with 5.7x, while Retail lags at 0.48x as of Day 3.

headline: Sollfege IPO Day 3: Subscribed 1.91x
summary: Sollfege Smart Electronics IPO sees steady retail interest, reaching 1.91x overall subscription by Day 3. QIB demand remains absent as the issue closes on Oct 5.

headline: Shree TNB Polymers IPO Day 5 Update
summary: Shree TNB Polymers IPO is fully subscribed at 1.05x on Day 5. QIB demand remains flat at 0.75x while NII leads with 2.65x subscription.

headline: Eventions IPO Day 3: QIB Leads Demand
summary: Eventions IPO subscribed 1.85x by Day 3. QIB demand stands at 26.18x, while Retail and NII remain under-subscribed.

headline: Paramount Syntex IPO Day 3: QIBs Lead Demand
summary: Paramount Syntex IPO sees strong institutional interest with QIBs subscribed 119.29x. Overall subscription stands at 1.35x as of Day 3, with retail demand remaining muted.
